title: The $α$-Limit Problem: Convergence of a Linear Degenerate Interface Transmission Problem
summary: We study the singular limit of a family of linear degenerate interface transmission problems arising from a regularization procedure in the newly proposed Two-Parameter Diffuse Domain Method (DDM2p). For $α>0$, the regularized problem admits a strictly convex variational formulation on $H^{1}(Ω)$. In the limit $α\to0$, the problem degenerates to a weakly coupled interface system with a nonstandard energy structure.
